latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Privacy Concierge ("Guardian") skill for OpenClaw.

- Calculates real-time privacy scores based on user data exposures.
- Automates opt-out requests to 300+ data brokers and provides DSAR request tracking.
- Performs daily scans for new data appearances or breaches.
- Offers personalized privacy advice for social media and ad tracking.
- Supports persistent user memory via Supabase.
- Sends instant alerts for high-risk privacy events.
- Provides conversational, source-backed answers to privacy-related questions.
